Table: attendee
Description: Registry of people who may attend conference presentations. Attendee contact details and VIP status are stored here; nullable contact and VIP values support incomplete records.

Primary Key: attendee_id
Foreign Keys: None

Columns:
  - attendee_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for an attendee.
  - first_name (VARCHAR(20)): Attendee's given name.
  - last_name (VARCHAR(20)): Attendee's family name.
  - phone (VARCHAR(10)): Contact phone number stored as text so leading zeroes are preserved; may be NULL.
  - email (VARCHAR(40)): Contact email address; may be NULL, and duplicate values are possible in the practice data.
  - vip (VARCHAR(4)): VIP indicator, typically 'yes' or 'no'; may be NULL.

Table: room
Description: Conference room inventory. Each record identifies a room's floor and seating capacity, including rooms with low capacity for edge-case queries.

Primary Key: room_id
Foreign Keys: None

Columns:
  - room_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for a conference room.
  - floor_number (INTEGER): Floor on which the room is located.
  - seat_capacity (INTEGER): Maximum number of seats in the room.

Table: company
Description: Organizations associated with the conference. A company may have a primary contact attendee; company names are not unique, and contact or description values may be NULL.

Primary Key: company_id
Foreign Keys: primary_contact_attendee_id ? attendee.attendee_id

Columns:
  - company_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for a company.
  - name (VARCHAR(20)): Company or organization name; duplicate names are present in the data.
  - description (VARCHAR(20)): Short description of the company's business or industry; may be NULL.
  - primary_contact_attendee_id (INTEGER): Nullable foreign key to the attendee who is the company's primary contact.

Table: presentation
Description: Scheduled conference presentations. A presentation may be associated with a booking company and room, both of which are nullable, and has a start and end time.

Primary Key: presentation_id
Foreign Keys: booked_company_id ? company.company_id | booked_room_id ? room.room_id

Columns:
  - presentation_id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for a presentation.
  - booked_company_id (INTEGER): Nullable foreign key to the company booking or sponsoring the presentation.
  - booked_room_id (INTEGER): Nullable foreign key to the room assigned to the presentation.
  - start_time (TIMESTAMP): Scheduled presentation start date and time.
  - end_time (TIMESTAMP): Scheduled presentation end date and time; constrained to be later than start_time.

Table: presentation_attendance
Description: Ticket and attendance junction table linking attendees to presentations. Each ticket is unique; multiple tickets can link the same attendee to the same presentation in the edge-case data.

Primary Key: ticket_id
Foreign Keys: presentation_id ? presentation.presentation_id | attendee_id ? attendee.attendee_id

Columns:
  - ticket_id (VARCHAR(10)): Unique ticket identifier for an attendance record.
  - presentation_id (INTEGER): Foreign key to the presentation associated with this ticket.
  - attendee_id (INTEGER): Foreign key to the attendee associated with this ticket.
